tech.name: Frontend Developer
tech.description: Builds the visual and interactive parts of websites with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern UI frameworks.
roadmap: 1. Learn HTML and CSS fundamentals (1-2 months)
2. Build confidence with JavaScript (2-3 months)
3. Choose a framework such as React or Vue (2-3 months)
4. Publish well-documented projects on GitHub
5. Apply for an internship, junior role, or first freelance project

tech.name: Backend Developer
tech.description: Builds server-side logic, databases, and APIs that power applications behind the scenes.
roadmap: 1. Learn Python or Node.js (2-3 months)
2. Study SQL and database fundamentals (1-2 months)
3. Build and document a REST API
4. Learn container basics with Docker
5. Explore a cloud platform such as AWS or Google Cloud

tech.name: Data Scientist
tech.description: Analyzes large datasets and builds statistical or machine-learning models to support decisions.
roadmap: 1. Learn Python and Pandas (2 months)
2. Study statistics fundamentals (1-2 months)
3. Learn core machine-learning concepts (3-4 months)
4. Practice with open datasets and Kaggle
5. Publish reproducible portfolio projects

tech.name: Mobile Developer
tech.description: Designs and builds applications for iOS and Android devices.
roadmap: 1. Choose Flutter, React Native, Swift, or Kotlin
2. Learn mobile interface patterns (1-2 months)
3. Connect an app to a backend or Firebase
4. Test on real devices and publish a small app
5. Apply for internships or junior mobile roles

tech.name: DevOps Engineer
tech.description: Automates software delivery, infrastructure, monitoring, and reliable deployment workflows.
roadmap: 1. Learn Linux and networking fundamentals
2. Practice with Docker
3. Build a CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions
4. Study infrastructure and Kubernetes concepts
5. Deploy and monitor a small cloud application

tech.name: Cybersecurity Specialist
tech.description: Protects systems and data by identifying risks, monitoring threats, and improving security controls.
roadmap: 1. Learn networking fundamentals
2. Build confidence with Linux
3. Study security fundamentals and responsible disclosure
4. Practice legally on TryHackMe or Hack The Box
5. Prepare for an entry-level certification or internship

design.name: UX/UI Designer
design.description: Researches user needs and designs interfaces that balance clarity, accessibility, and visual quality.
roadmap: 1. Learn visual and interaction design fundamentals
2. Build prototypes in Figma
3. Practice interviews and usability testing
4. Create three detailed case studies
5. Apply for internships or junior design roles

design.name: Graphic Designer
design.description: Creates visual identities, campaigns, publications, and digital assets for organizations and products.
roadmap: 1. Learn typography, layout, and color theory
2. Practice with Photoshop and Illustrator
3. Build a focused portfolio
4. Work on real briefs or community projects
5. Choose a specialty such as branding or editorial design

design.name: Motion Designer
design.description: Creates animation, visual effects, and motion graphics for products, media, and campaigns.
roadmap: 1. Learn After Effects fundamentals
2. Study timing and animation principles
3. Experiment with 3D tools
4. Produce a concise showreel
5. Apply to studios or take on small client projects

health.name: Health Informatics Specialist
health.description: Improves healthcare systems by organizing clinical data and supporting safe digital workflows.
roadmap: 1. Learn how healthcare systems and clinical data work
2. Study SQL and data analysis
3. Learn privacy, ethics, and interoperability standards
4. Complete a health-data project
5. Apply to health IT teams or relevant degree programs

health.name: Nutritionist / Dietitian
health.description: Uses nutrition science to help people plan healthy diets and work toward health goals.
roadmap: 1. Research the accredited education required in your country
2. Complete supervised clinical practice
3. Meet local registration or licensing requirements
4. Choose a specialty such as sports or clinical nutrition
5. Build experience in a healthcare setting

health.name: Mental Health Counselor
health.description: Supports people facing stress, anxiety, life transitions, and other mental-health challenges.
roadmap: 1. Research the psychology or counseling degree required locally
2. Complete supervised clinical hours
3. Meet local licensing requirements
4. Choose an evidence-based specialty
5. Continue professional supervision and training

business.name: Digital Marketer
business.description: Plans and measures online campaigns across search, social media, content, and paid channels.
roadmap: 1. Learn marketing fundamentals and customer research
2. Study web analytics
3. Practice with a small campaign or community project
4. Document outcomes in a case study
5. Apply to an internship, agency, or junior role

business.name: Product Manager
business.description: Connects customer needs, business goals, and engineering work to guide a product's direction.
roadmap: 1. Learn product discovery and delivery fundamentals
2. Join a product team in an entry-level role
3. Practice analytics and user interviews
4. Lead a small product improvement
5. Apply to associate product programs

business.name: Entrepreneur / Startup Founder
business.description: Builds an organization around a problem, tests solutions, and accepts significant uncertainty and risk.
roadmap: 1. Identify a specific problem worth solving
2. Interview potential users
3. Build the smallest useful prototype
4. Find and learn from early customers
5. Improve the product using evidence

media.name: Content Creator
media.description: Creates video, audio, written, or visual content and develops an audience around a focused topic.
roadmap: 1. Choose a clear topic and audience
2. Learn basic recording and editing
3. Publish consistently and gather feedback
4. Improve titles, discovery, and retention
5. Explore ethical monetization options

media.name: Digital Journalist
media.description: Researches and produces accurate stories, interviews, and reports for digital audiences.
roadmap: 1. Study reporting, media law, and ethics
2. Write for a school or community publication
3. Seek an internship or mentorship
4. Build a portfolio of accurate published work
5. Apply to newsrooms or independent outlets

media.name: Social Media Manager
media.description: Plans content, manages online communities, and measures social-media performance for a brand.
roadmap: 1. Study major platforms and audience behavior
2. Practice content design and copywriting
3. Learn to interpret analytics
4. Support a small organization or community
5. Build a portfolio with measurable outcomes

psychology.name: Human Resources Specialist
psychology.description: Supports hiring, employee development, workplace policy, and organizational culture.
roadmap: 1. Study human resources, business, or psychology
2. Learn employment practices in your country
3. Seek an internship or recruiting coordinator role
4. Build confidence with HR information systems
5. Work toward a relevant professional certification

psychology.name: Life / Career Coach
psychology.description: Helps clients clarify goals, plan transitions, and stay accountable through structured coaching conversations.
roadmap: 1. Research evidence-based coaching and ethical boundaries
2. Complete a reputable training program
3. Practice under supervision and gather feedback
4. Choose a clear coaching focus
5. Build a transparent professional practice

psychology.name: UX / Social Researcher
psychology.description: Studies human behavior and needs to produce evidence that improves products, services, or policy.
roadmap: 1. Learn qualitative and quantitative research methods
2. Practice analysis with R, Python, or SPSS
3. Run a small ethical research study
4. Build case studies that explain decisions and limitations
5. Apply to research internships or junior roles
